premises.statement: The greatest version value within each template ID identifies its most recent version.
premises.evidence_of_dependence: (version = MAX(version) OVER (PARTITION BY id)) AS is_most_recent_version
premises.reason: The contract requires the flag but does not establish how recency is determined, which can affect current-template selection.

premises.statement: Ordering the raw version values produces the same maximum as ordering their contracted DOUBLE representations.
premises.reason: If raw versions are strings, their maximum can differ from the numeric maximum used to identify the latest version.
